scoring_justification: Recompute agreement metrics from the agent's CSV against paper-reported reference values; trend checks recompute monotonicity and flatness from submitted temperature series.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for 300K thermal conductivity of GeH: pristine bulk, nanocrystalline lb16, nanocrystalline lb34, amorphous limit.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: Appl. Phys. Lett. 109, 131907 (2016), text and Fig. 3. Pristine bulk: 8.8 W/mK at 300K; nanocrystalline lb16: 0.53 W/mK; nanocrystalline lb34: 0.74 W/mK; amorphous limit: 0.29 W/mK.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly extracted from the paper's reported calculated values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own computational results that the reproduction aims to match.

outputs.description: Lattice thermal conductivity of GeH computed via phonon BTE for different scattering scenarios. The hidden checker compares the values at 300 K to paper reference values with tolerance, and also verifies temperature trends (pristine decreasing, nanocrystalline increasing, amorphous flat).

output_contract.notes: Units are W/mK. The agent must compute the results from first principles; the hidden checker checks consistency with known reference values within physically reasonable tolerances. Temperature trends are also evaluated.
